title: fix(service-analytics): a picklist-bound select dimension serves its category labels in the request locale
body:
Fixes #22178

Clause-②: no

A select dimension bound to a shared list (`picklist: 'NAME'`) now serves its chart and report category labels in the request's locale on `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`. Before this change it served the authored (English) labels under every `Accept-Language`.

## What changed

- **`packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts`, the `translateSelectOptions` bridge.** The synthetic field handed to `translateObject` now carries the dimension field's `picklist`. The value is read from the same served field the caller's `options` came from (`getObject(objectName).fields`). The resolver looks up `picklists.NAME.options.VALUE` only for a field that carries `picklist`, and the synthetic field used to carry `options` alone. A field with inline `options` has no `picklist`, so its synthetic field is built exactly as before.
- **`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts`, `createOrderLabelResolver.resolveLabels`.** For a select dimension, the sort-key pass now reads the options `translateSelectOptions` returns for the request locale, the same options the display pass reads. The `DimensionLabelDeps.translateSelectOptions` docblock now names the picklist address and both passes. The "Scope" section below explains why this file is in the PR.
- One `@objectstack/service-analytics` `patch` changeset.

## Rulings executed (triage comment 6052688863, verbatim; its one angle-bracket placeholder respelled NAME)

> - build the synthetic field with the dimension's `picklist`, so `picklists.NAME` translations apply
> - inline `options` behave as today
> - Pins: `Accept-Language: zh-CN` and `ja-JP` serve translated labels for a picklist-bound dimension; control: inline options are unchanged.
> - `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset for the analytics service.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1: confirmed on `6ed0c0f3`.** `plugin.ts:1071-1073` built a synthetic field holding only `name` and `options`. `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:3063-3068` calls `lookupPicklistOption` only when `typeof def.picklist === 'string'`.
- **H2: confirmed.** The engine's `getObject` serves the picklist-bound field with `picklist` next to its resolved `options` (`resolvePicklistFieldsOnto`, the served shape `PicklistServedFieldSchema` declares). The bridge reads `picklist` there, and the caller's signature is unchanged. The first test pins this precondition against a real `ObjectQL` engine.
- **H3: confirmed.** The picklist branch runs whenever `picklist` is set. The resolver's own precedence still applies: a field-level entry wins, then the list's entry. A `zh-CN` field-level entry for `logistics` pins it. A field with only inline `options` gets the same synthetic field as before.
- **H4: pinned at the service call the door makes.** The door lives in `@objectstack/rest`, which this package does not depend on, so the pins call `AnalyticsService.queryDataset` (the call `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` makes with the request's ExecutionContext). They run through the plugin's own composition, with a real `ObjectQL` engine on SQLite as `data` and an i18n service as `i18n`, on both strategies (native SQL and ObjectQL aggregate).

## Labels per locale

"Before" is `main`'s behaviour, measured by ablation A1 below. "After" is this branch. Fixture: `industry` is bound to picklist `os22178_industry`; `type` has inline options.

| locale | dimension | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| zh-CN | `industry` (picklist) | Education · Energy & Utilities · 物流运输 | 教育 · 能源公用事业 · 物流运输 |
| ja-JP | `industry` (picklist) | Education · Energy & Utilities · Logistics | 教育・学術 · エネルギー・公益 · ロジスティクス |
| zh-CN | `type` (inline, control) | 正式客户 · 合作伙伴 | 正式客户 · 合作伙伴 |
| ja-JP | `type` (inline, control) | 顧客 · パートナー | 顧客 · パートナー |
| none | both (control) | authored | authored |

`物流运输` in zh-CN comes from the field-level entry: it applied before, and it still beats the list's `物流` after. For each locale, every `industry` label equals what `translateObject` returns for the served object (the object-metadata door's answer for the same field).

Ascending `order` (with `limit: 1` keeping the first row):

| locale | dimension | before (authored-label order) | after (rendered-label order) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| zh-CN | `industry` | 教育 · 能源公用事业 · 物流运输 | 教育 · 物流运输 · 能源公用事业 |
| zh-CN | `type` | 正式客户 · 合作伙伴 | 合作伙伴 · 正式客户 |
| ja-JP | `industry` | 教育・学術 · エネルギー・公益 · ロジスティクス | エネルギー・公益 · ロジスティクス · 教育・学術 |
| ja-JP | `type` | 顧客 · パートナー | パートナー · 顧客 |
| none | both (control) | authored order | authored order |

## Scope: one step past the dispatch fence, and why

The dispatch fenced this card to the `translateSelectOptions` region of `plugin.ts`. Once the picklist-bound dimension's display labels were translated, the sort-key pass (`createOrderLabelResolver`) no longer matched the display for that dimension. An `order` sorted, and a `limit` windowed, by the English label while the row showed the translated one. Before the change both were English, so they agreed. Inline-options dimensions already had this gap, because the sort-key pass never read the locale.

The dev agent definition requires fixing a shipped defect that the change makes false, and that rule outranks a dispatch fence. So the fix is here, with its own pins and ablation (A2). It is two lines that mirror the display pass. No open PR touches `packages/services/service-analytics` (the file lists of all 11 open PRs were read).

The claim's file surface should add `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts` (`createOrderLabelResolver.resolveLabels`, the `DimensionLabelDeps.translateSelectOptions` docblock). Not touched: `packages/spec`, and the `admitObjectRead` region of `plugin.ts` that #22154 holds next.

## Tests (at `59ccbaf04d`)

- New: `src/__tests__/picklist-dimension-label-i18n.test.ts`, 26 passed (26).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 179 passed (179), Tests 4436 passed, 262 skipped (4698).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): exit 0. `--listFiles` includes the new test file (176 test files in the program).
- Dependency closure `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-analytics^...' build`: exit 0. `@objectstack/service-analytics` build: exit 0, `check-dts-emitted` 2/2.
- Narrowed lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 changed `.ts` files. The JSON reports 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, and none is ignored by `eslint.config.mjs`. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch. The full `pnpm lint` run is left to CI.

## Ablations

Each ablation used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode under the verify lock: the anchor must hit, the on-disk blob change is verified, and the file is restored on exit, INT or TERM. The subject is imported relatively (`../plugin.js`, `../dimension-labels.js`) and resolves to `src/`, so neither leg goes through `dist/`.

- **A1: drop the `picklist` spread in `plugin.ts`.** Anchor 1 to 0, blob `b272fe903c6e` to `fa6bf8178e43`. Result: 12 failed, 14 passed. The 8 picklist display pins and the 4 picklist sort pins failed. The inline controls, the no-locale controls and the precondition stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`b272fe903c6e`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **A2: sort-key pass reads `meta.options` again (`dimension-labels.ts`).** Anchor 1 to 0, blob `228491a908f1` to `7050404c0de1`. Result: 8 failed, 18 passed. Exactly the 8 sort pins failed, each receiving the authored-label order (for example `正式客户, 合作伙伴` where `合作伙伴, 正式客户` was expected). Restored: blob equals HEAD (`228491a908f1`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- A fixture guard pins that the rendered-label order is the order `localeCompare` (the executor's comparator) produces, and that it differs from the authored-label order for every locale and dimension. So the sort pins cannot pass vacuously.

## Gates (at `59ccbaf04d`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 64 commands from the merge base `6ed0c0f3e` (4 paths). All 64 exited 0. Reconciliation with `--ran` reported: "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

The derivation names no i18n family. As extra evidence, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:i18n-stale-fill` and `check:i18n-coverage` were also run, and each exited 0 with an OK line.

The derivation itself lists what it leaves outside the 64 commands and does not measure: the CI jobs scheduled by these paths (Test Core, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood, Build Core), the CI type-check lanes, and the artifact-roster families. CI runs those.

## Acceptance notes

- The HTTP door itself was not booted in-package. The door hands its ExecutionContext to `queryDataset` unchanged, so the pins stand at that call.
- The executor compares sort labels with `localeCompare()` and passes no locale, so rendered labels collate in the process's root order, not the request locale's. For example, zh-CN pinyin order would be 教育 · 能源公用事业 · 物流运输, and root order is 教育 · 物流运输 · 能源公用事业. No contract names locale-aware collation. This is noted, not filed.
